_comment: P1-84 -- the three default NUMBERS that disarm the system. From docs/CONFIG_DEFAULTS.md rules R4 and R5 and section 3.2. The red tests are the three TestP184_* methods in tests/RiskGuardAddOnTests.cs; they are written and RED. Tests are protected.

tickets.title: Three defaults that make the guard easier to switch off than to live with
tickets.defect:
`P1-84`. Three numbers, one failure mode: **a default that fires on a normal day trains you to disarm the system**, and a guard that is off during the one session that mattered has provided exactly nothing.

(1) R5, AND THE MOST LIKELY REASON THIS SYSTEM GETS SWITCHED OFF. `StopGuardConfig.StopAttachSeconds` defaults to `3` while `OnMissing` defaults to `"Flatten"`. Three seconds from fill to a working stop, or the guard flattens you. Enter manually, reach for the mouse to place the stop, get flattened -- on a day when nothing was wrong. The number is only reasonable for the `AutoStop` action, where an invented stop is recoverable; it is not reasonable when the penalty is being taken out of the trade.

(2) R4, TWO NAMES FOR ONE CONCEPT CARRYING TWO NUMBERS. `CopierRelationship.MaxPositionSize` and `CopierGroup.MaxPositionSize` default to `100`; `SizingConfig.MaxContractsPerAccount` defaults to `10`. They cap the same quantity -- contracts held on a follower account -- and the LOWER always binds, so **the copier's cap has never stopped anything**. It is not a limit, it is decoration that reads like one, and two limits on one quantity is worse than one because you size against whichever file you happened to open. 100 MNQ is roughly $4.5M of notional; that is not a cap, it is the absence of one.

(3) A PRECONDITION DISABLED BY ITS OWN DEFAULT. `RiskConfig.MinShadowSessions` defaults to `0`, and `RunPreflight`'s FR-29 gate reads `_config.MinShadowSessions > 0 && _shadowSessionsCompleted < _config.MinShadowSessions`. Zero does not mean "no sessions required" -- it means the precondition DOES NOT RUN. Live arming is gated on nothing at all, which is the same shape as `P1-82`: something that reads like a safeguard and is not one.
tickets.spec:
Three literals.

A. `StopGuardConfig.StopAttachSeconds`: `3` becomes `15`. Long enough to place a stop by hand, short enough that an unstopped position does not survive a spike. Say on the declaration that the number is tied to `OnMissing = "Flatten"` -- if the action were `AutoStop` a much shorter deadline would be right.

B. `MaxPositionSize` on BOTH `CopierRelationship` and `CopierGroup`: `100` becomes `10`. Both, or the group path keeps the old number and R4 is only half closed -- the shape this repo keeps finding. Say on the declarations that this deliberately agrees with `RiskConfig.Sizing.MaxContractsPerAccount`, that the lower of the two always binds, and that raising one without the other silently makes it dead again.

C. `RiskConfig.MinShadowSessions`: `0` becomes `5`. Roughly a week of sessions watched without the guard wanting to intervene wrongly, before it can be pointed at live money. Say on the declaration that the preflight gate short-circuits at zero, so zero disables the gate rather than relaxing it.

WHAT NOT TO DO:
* Do NOT change `StopGuard.OnMissing`. `"Flatten"` is the right default and is documented as the most important one in the file: the alternative invents a stop at a guessed offset, and flat is always a known quantity.
* Do NOT change `MaxContractsPerAccount` or `MaxContractsAggregate`. The guard's numbers are the ones being agreed WITH.
* Do NOT change any dollar-denominated default (`PnLRules.DailyLossLimit`, `TrailingDrawdown`, `EvaluationTargetProfit`, the `FirmMirror` amounts). Those are R3 and they must come from the firm profile, not from a better guess. That is `F-9` and it is not this ticket.
* Do NOT add validation, clamping or migration. Existing config files keep their stored values; only the default for a field that is absent changes.
tickets.context:
THE THREE TESTS ARE NOT CONSTANT CHECKS, and satisfying them by pinning a literal somewhere else will not work.

* The copier-cap test asserts an INEQUALITY -- `MaxPositionSize <= MaxContractsPerAccount` -- so that raising the guard's cap for a bigger account cannot silently make the copier's dead again.
* The stop-deadline test is CONDITIONAL on `OnMissing == "Flatten"`. Changing the action legitimately releases the floor; changing the action to dodge the test would fail nothing here but would break the StopGuard tests.
* The shadow-session test also reads `addons/RiskGuardAddOn.cs` and asserts the `> 0` short-circuit is still there, because the value and the short-circuit are only a defect TOGETHER.

FIXTURES ALREADY SET THESE VALUES. Around forty test fixtures assign `MaxPositionSize` explicitly, so the default change does not move them. One fixture asserts that a newly created group takes `MaxPositionSize == 100` from the initialiser; it is in a protected file and will be updated separately -- do not try to keep the old default to satisfy it.

ASCII only. C# 8.0 / .NET Framework 4.8 and a net8.0 test build.
